builds.name: Reference: Mana burst
builds.goal: Reference for Veigar: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A scaling burst mage who earns AP through spell hits and takedowns while using a cage to restrict movement. The cage creates a landing window for delayed W and a missing-health finisher. Fix earned AP and target missing health for R. Defensive builds may leverage existing AP but cage landing still determines output; no infinite stacks to justify tankiness. AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure.
builds.summary: AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Veigar: Fix earned AP and target missing health for R. Defensive builds may leverage existing AP but cage landing still determines output; no infinite stacks to justify tankiness.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

kitEvidence.formula:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7) × AP] magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacksLarge@ stacks instead.

Veigar's Abilities grant him [1] stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional [5] stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar [1] Ability Power.
Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for [1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 / 2.5] seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.

Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing [85 / 140 / 195 / 250 / 305 + (0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9 / 1 / 1.1) × AP] magic damage.

Every @Spell.VeigarPassive:PStacksPerDarkMatterCDR@ stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Spell.VeigarPassive:DarkMatterCDRIncrement*100@%.

Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between [175 / 250 / 325 + (0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75) × AP] and [(175 / 250 / 325 + (0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75) × AP) × (2)] magic damage, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.
